versions.content: The Service Discovery module shall be able to reference Socket Connections and SocketConnectionGroups per Service Instance/Eventgroup. See the following configuration parameters: • SdClientServiceTcpRef (Service Instance and Eventgroups) • SdClientServiceUdpRef (Service Instance and Eventgroups) • SdConsumedEventGroupMulticastGroupRef (Eventgroup) • SdServerServiceTcpRef (Service Instance and Eventgroups) • SdServerServiceUdpRef (Service Instance and Eventgroups) • SdMulticastEventSoConRef in SdEventHandlerMulticast (Eventgroup)
